scope: Synthetic one-layer BF16 SwiGLU AFD FFN proof of concept; not full-model serving, TTFT, or a new DeepEP comparison.

hardware.placement: two four-GPU NVLink domains, four FFN + four Attention

method: Attention endpoint is graph-captured for every variant. Same DeepGEMM tuning hint and weights. Rotated variant order, 3 repeats x30 samples after all planned input epochs were warmed. Metric: median across repeats of each repeat median max-Attention-rank host-wall roundtrip. Native GIN windows separate from PyTorch memory.
limitations: All receive tensors remain conservative-capacity allocations; exact sizing applies only to eager compute intermediates.
Current pool reserves the safe receive bound; it is not an adaptive or capacity-budgeted chunk allocator.
FFN peak increment subtracts pretrial allocations including resident weights; it is not total GPU memory. Values are the mean of per-rank peaks on four FFN GPUs.
Uniform timed routing; empty/skewed/changed routes and delayed peers checked separately.
post_run_cleanup: Removed an unused FFN reference helper and unused weight-size property; executable paths unchanged.

profiling.scope: Separate profiled hybrid run, 2048 tokens/source. Median stage sums over 4 FFN ranks x3 sampled iterations. Durations include peer waits; do not sum medians across ranks or equate GIN kernel time with wire time.

initial_capacity_scan_profiling.scope: Separate profiled hybrid run, 2048 tokens/source. Median stage sums over 4 FFN ranks x3 sampled iterations. Durations include peer waits; do not sum medians across ranks or equate GIN kernel time with wire time.
